draft.title: Internal migration in Australia
card: Internal migration is when people move from one place to another inside their own country. Many Australians do this, moving between states and between cities and towns.
Interstate moves
Many people move to Queensland and Western Australia. Common reasons are a job, such as in mining or building, or a warmer climate.
Sea change
a move from a big city to a town on the coast, for a slower pace of life, a beach lifestyle or cheaper housing.
Tree change
a move from a big city to a country town or inland area, for similar reasons such as space, quiet and lower costs.
draft.remember: Australians move within their country for work, climate or lifestyle, including sea changes and tree changes.

a.q: Priya leaves her flat in Melbourne to live in a small coastal town for a slower pace of life. What is this move called?
a.why: Priya moves from a big city to a town on the coast for lifestyle reasons, so it is a sea change. A tree change is also a move from a city, but it is to a country or inland area, not the coast.
a.clue: Look at where she is moving to: the coast or inland?

b.q: Sam moves from Adelaide to a country town inland to get more space and lower housing costs. Which description fits best?
opts: Internal migration, as a tree change
Internal migration, as a sea change
International migration, as a tree change
International migration, as a sea change
b.why: Sam stays inside Australia, so this is internal migration. The move is from a city to an inland country town, so it is a tree change. A sea change would be a move to the coast.
b.clue: Does Sam cross a national border, and is the new town on the coast?

b.best: Internal migration, as a tree change

a.why: Priya moves from a big city to a town on the coast for lifestyle reasons, so it is a sea change. A tree change is also a move from a city, but it is to a country or inland area, not the coast. She stays in Victoria, so it is not an interstate move.
a.clue: Look at where she is moving to: the coast or inland?

b.q: Leo moves from Sydney to Perth to take a job at a mine in Western Australia. Which description fits his move best?
opts: A sea change, as Perth is on the coast
A tree change, as mines are inland
An interstate move for a warmer climate
b.why: Leo moves from New South Wales to Western Australia to take a job, so it is an interstate move for work. Perth is on the coast, but it is a big city, not a coastal town, and he moves for a job rather than lifestyle, so it is not a sea change.
b.clue: Why is Leo moving, and is Perth a small town?
